name: @agentick/store-next
description: Generic store substrate for Agentick v2 — the `MemoryCollection<T, Q>` in-memory collection-store generic and the `runStoreConformance` shared conformance skeleton. Parameterize one generic (backend / keyOf / matchQuery / prunePredicate) to get a store-backed harness's default backing; no hand-rolled `Map` per harness. Implements the `CollectionStore<T, Q>` port from `@agentick/spec-next`. Bundled into the agentick metapackage; not published independently.
author: Ryan Lindgren
